prompts.frame:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one reusable hollow picture frame master for a hand-painted cozy lunar furniture game.
Reference image 1 is the precise painting/material style: sculpted cream lacquer, restrained warm gold bevels, thin warm contour drawing, gentle hand-painted marbling. Reference image 2 is the accepted furniture bookcase; match its material treatment EXACTLY, not generic flat SVG. Reference image 3 is ONLY the size/opening guide and is the edit target: replace its crude geometric gold bars and navy circle badges.
Draw ONE SQUARE PICTURE FRAME seen EXACTLY STRAIGHT-ON, no perspective, no visible side plane. Keep the square outer rectangle and square transparent opening, consistent rail thickness about 8 percent of outer width. All ornament must fit inside the outer square bounds. Gentle rounded bevel moulding, broad creamy ivory painted rail with subtle painterly grain, thin gold inner and outer raised edges, softly sculpted four rounded corner caps just like the bookcase feet/caps. One elegant small raised crescent at the center of the top rail, and two small four-point stars quietly linked by one gold swoosh on the bottom rail. Tiny corner stars in gold on cream, NO navy circular sticker badges. The look must be softly sculpted and hand-painted with real highlights and material depth rather than line graphics. Restraint: mostly cream, small amount of gold, perhaps a very narrow navy inner fillet only. True transparent outside AND true transparent central opening. No painting, no glass, no checkerboard image, no background, no lighting shadows, no text. Clean uncropped isolated master with padding. This front-plane texture will be reused at three fixed sizes.
prompts.window:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single hollow window-frame FRONT-PLANE master for a hand-painted cozy lunar furniture game. Image 1 is style reference only; image 2 is the accepted detailed cream-and-gold furniture bookcase, match its materials and sculpted design.
Create ONE rectangular landscape window frame, outer width to height ratio exactly 512:340 (1.506). Seen precisely STRAIGHT-ON, parallel projection, no perspective, no side faces, no projecting sill, not an isometric window. Cream lacquer wood with subtly hand-painted marbling, rounded sculpted bevel rails, thin warm gold raised edges and small rounded corner caps. Its upper inner rim has a gentle shallow arch and a creamy raised header with one gold crescent flanked by two tiny four-point stars, similar to the bookcase curved top apron. Upper header and inner arch must stay within the rectangular outer bounds, no crest sticking out. TWO large open panes divided only by one slender elegant central cream-and-gold vertical mullion, no horizontal grids or diagonal lines. Rich but restrained artisanal finish, same warm illustration contours, volumetric paint highlights, soft cream values as the bookcase; not flat geometric outlines. No glass, no scenery. Actual transparent exterior AND actual transparent holes between mullions. No wall, no room, no furniture, no text, no ground shadow, no background. Entire outer rectangular frame remains inside image with clear padding. All straight horizontal and vertical edges remain straight and mutually parallel.
prompts.wall:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flat wall surface material illustration, not a room. Images 1 and 2 are strictly PAINTING STYLE and palette references. Match the soft warm cream lacquer/plaster and very restrained gold in the accepted furniture.
A completely flat front-facing rectangular creamy ivory satin plaster wallpaper swatch, width:height 1.237:1. No perspective, no room geometry, no windows, no objects, no frames or border. Delicate hand-painted mottled ivory plaster, faint shallow embossed crescent-and-four-point-star pairs widely spaced in the upper half only, just a few very small pairs, creamy tonal relief with a tiny warm-gold edge, NOT bright flat icons, NOT large orbit diagrams or straight connecting lines. Lower half mostly plain softly brushed cream with subtle texture. Keep almost all area calm cream, very small gold. Same stylized illustrative warm outlines and soft relief finish as furniture, avoid photorealism, heavy 3D shadows, dirt, grunge, wallpaper floral patterns. Even material lighting, no vignette or scene illumination. Opaque edge-to-edge material surface, no transparency, no text. Pattern is built into the surface, not pasted on top. This will be projected onto an immutable wall and masked around fixed openings.
prompts.floor:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE flat top-down square floor material swatch, no room. Images 1 and 2 are strictly PAINTING STYLE/palette references, do not copy their camera or room layout.
Draw an opaque edge-to-edge SQUARE pale ivory/light warm oak lacquer floor, hand-painted polished cozy game art matching cream furniture. Precisely TOP DOWN orthographic surface, no perspective, no walls, no objects, no carpet, no light shadow or vignette. Broad straight wood boards running vertically with fine soft grain and sparse staggered horizontal seams, all board lines exactly axis-aligned. Gentle cream variations, delicate painted bevel seam highlights, warm small contour lines with softly modeled depth. Integrate a restrained lunar brass marquetry trim only in the outer 10 percent perimeter: one fine gold inset border with softly curved corner joins and just a couple of little star details INLAID in the wood, same warm metal treatment as the furniture; tiny lunar curve/crescent accents integrated into corner trim rather than four separate circular stamp logos. The central 80 percent should be simple beautiful pale boards. Do not add visible diagrams, large moon icons, navy circular badges, extensive ornament, dense motifs, or high-contrast stripes. Surface itself must show artisanal texture rather than flat vector lines. Neutral even material lighting. No text, no background, no extra framing outside the square.
